Re-evaluating with the exact ellipse condition \(1<t<4,\ t\ne \frac52\):  
- (1) is still true, since every ellipse case satisfies \(1<t<4\).  
- (2) Hyperbola requires \((4-t)(t-1)<0\), so \(t<1\) or \(t>4\); true.  
- (3) False: \(t=\frac52\) gives a circle \(x^2+y^2=\frac32\).  
- (4) Major axis on \(x\)-axis requires \(4-t>t-1>0\), i.e. \(1<t<\frac52\), not \(1<t<\frac32\); false.  

Thus the correct propositions are \(\boxed{(1),(2)}\).
